versions.changelog: V2 remediation: add Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

Initial release of Dry-Clean Pickup Schedule Keeper.

- Enables users to track dry-cleaning orders with pickup dates, ticket references, garment categories, special notes, and reminder text.
- Provides a structured, one-page pickup schedule and a customizable bag tag note template.
- Focuses strictly on managing pickup logistics and reminders—does not handle payments, disputes, or customer accounts.
- Includes clear instructions to confirm missing or uncertain order details with the cleaner.
- Offers a step-by-step checklist to prepare for pickup and organize post-pickup tasks.
